news.title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
news.summary: Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin nears $64,000 as Anthropic’s record IPO lifts tech
news.summary: Nasdaq futures jumped nearly 2% with Anthropic shares indicated as much as 24% higher, and one analyst said IPO money could flow back into crypto.

news.title: 米シティ、ビットコインとイーサリアムの目標を約12％・約6％引き下げ
news.summary: 米シティグループは、ビットコインとイーサリアムの基本シナリオの目標価格をそれぞれ9万9,532ドル、2,838ドルに引き下げた。BTCの200日移動平均線割れとETFの資金流出を挙げ、短期の資金フロー判断も「中立」に下げた。

news.title: グレースケール、ビットコインのリスク再評価を提言　変動率は約43％に低下
news.summary: 米グレースケールは18日のレポートで、ビットコインのボラティリティが約43%まで低下したとして、リスク評価の見直しを提言した。JPモルガンの長期予測や、少数の急騰日がリターンを左右するファットテール特性もあわせて解説した。

news.title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $306.4 million Wednesday, pushing their combined assets to $77.7 billion as Bitcoin briefly traded below $63,000.

news.title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
news.summary: The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.

news.title: Bitcoin retests $62K as Nasdaq futures rise ahead of Anthropic debut
news.summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $63,500 after its second dip to $62,000 this week, while Anthropic priced its record $81.3 billion IPO at $83 a share.

news.title: コインシェアーズが26年3Qの決算発表、ETHとSOLの売却に再度言及
news.summary: コインシェアーズは、2026年3Qの未監査決算を発表。仮想通貨のイーサリアムとソラナの売却に再度言及し、売却代金は自社株買いプログラムの原資にする計画だと説明した。

news.title: Bitcoin carry trades could beat Treasury bills in 2027, Sygnum predicts
news.summary: Sygnum predicts that Bitcoin carry trades may offer higher returns than Treasury bills in 2027, following a sharp drop in funding rates that made the strategy less compelling in 2026.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Ethereum block builders received the most in a $3.4 million vault hack, data shows
news.summary: An automated trading bot copied the attack on K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, taking more than half the funds and paying most of its proceeds to get its transactions processed first.

news.title: Bitcoin miner that sold its last BTC warns it may run short of cash for $1.2 billion AI deal
news.summary: Hyperscale Data needs another $74.8 million to complete its Michigan data center project, even after selling its remaining bitcoin and raising fresh debt.

news.title: 米金融大手、ETF経由のビットコイン保有拡大　ウェルズは顧客分で倍増
news.summary: SECに提出された7〜9月期の13Fで、ウェルズ・ファーゴやゴールドマン・サックスなど米金融大手が現物ビットコインETFの保有を拡大していたことが分かった。一方、11月に入りETFからの資金流出とBTC安が続いている。

news.title: バンガード指数ファンド、メタプラネット株1800万株保有　以前比15％増＝報道
news.summary: 米資産運用大手バンガードの指数ファンドが、ビットコイン保有企業メタプラネットの株式を1,800万株保有していることが報じられた。評価額は2,200万ドル。メタプラネットは11月30日付でMSCI指数から除外される予定だ。

news.title: 上場マイナーのビットコイン保有、1月以降ほぼ半減＝グラスノード
news.summary: グラスノードによると、上場マイナー6社のビットコイン保有量は1月以降ほぼ半減した。MARAは9月末以降に1万3597BTCを売却し、ライオットも保有を2,418BTCまで減らした。売却資金はAIデータセンター転換と借入返済に向かう。

news.title: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is buying its CEO’s venture capital business, Tribe
news.summary: Sethi, who was appointed co-CEO of Kraken in October 2024, is also the chairman of Tribe Capital.

news.title: Tether invokes The Big Short in swipe at S&P over USDT reserve risks
news.summary: S&P Global made no downward adjustment in its latest Stablecoin Stability Assessment, as 5 is the lowest available score.

news.title: MARA prices $185M debt offering after $1.1B Bitcoin sale
news.summary: The Bitcoin miner is taking on new debt to finance its AI infrastructure expansion, with the Long Ridge acquisition adding nearly $69 million in annual interest costs.

news.title: $25M Ethereum MEV acquittal tests criminal enforcement limits
news.summary: BlackRock’s staked Ether ETF earns a cut of what traders pay for priority on Ethereum, the acquittal left the legal risk to that income unresolved.

news.title: Bitcoin, stocks wobble as Fed’s Waller talks of ‘shock’ 50-point rate hike
news.summary: Bitcoin price action dropped below $63,000 after fresh hawkish comments from the Fed as Nvidia earnings optimism faded.

news.title: German judge proposes dropping Movie2k case if operator hands over $2.56 billion in bitcoin
news.summary: Prosecutors estimate the defendant still holds 56,000 BTC, meaning the proposed deal would leave him with roughly $1 billion.

news.title: Hong Kong wants banks to use AI to catch crypto crime before money disappears
news.summary: As Hong Kong pushes banks to use AI to combat crypto crime, experts say the technology must detect suspicious transfers without putting customer funds at risk.

news.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 6: FE Covenants — Enforcing covenants through cryptographically restricted signing keys
news.summary: FE covenants encode spending constraints into the signing key, so only transactions that satisfy a predefined condition can be signed.

news.title: CoinShares sells all treasury ETH, halves SOL holdings for buybacks
news.summary: The October sales raised $19.3 million, nearly half the $40 million CoinShares can spend on buybacks before its next annual meeting.
